findings.finding: Optional Supabase email-link parent sign-in uses auth.getUser() and public publishable key
findings.implication: Reuse existing parent authentication; server/database must independently verify identity

findings.finding: Up to eight child explorer profiles stored locally, selected by activeId; profile IDs are strings of 8–80 permitted characters
findings.implication: Observation UI must resolve the selected child and never infer ownership solely from localStorage

findings.finding: Family snapshot revision RPC checks auth.uid() and profile key under parent_id, with direct UPDATE revoked
findings.implication: Existing snapshot protections do not automatically authorise new observation tables

findings.finding: Live Supabase auth and cross-parent RLS tests documented as unverified
findings.implication: Production observation storage blocked pending staging and live verification

findings.finding: family_snapshots keyed by parent_id and profile_key; cloud list is capped at eight
findings.implication: Prefer foreign-key linkage to parent-owned snapshot profile identity; investigate deletion and profile-key lifecycle before schema migration

decisions: Do not store observation notes in generic progress snapshots without privacy review
Use verified auth.uid() and parent-owned profile identity in database policies
Prototype and test on staging before any production migration
openQuestions: Does production Supabase have migrations 003–005 applied and verified?
How are explorer IDs generated and retained when profiles are removed?
Should observations be retained when a child profile is deleted?
Which lawful basis, retention and parent export/erasure controls will apply?
